Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the director of fish and wildlife to carry out predatory animal control functions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to control of predatory animals; adding a newsection to chapter 77.12 RCW; making an appropriation; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The director may control predatory animals that the directordetermines to be injurious to livestock, crops, and property and mayfor this purpose enter into written agreements with the federal andstate governments, political subdivisions and agencies of suchgovernments, political subdivisions and agencies of the state includingcounties, municipal corporations and associations, and individuals whensuch cooperation will implement the control of predators injurious tolivestock, crops, and property. (2) The director may make expenditures and contract for personalservices, control materials, and equipment as required to carry outpredatory animal control functions.

The sum of fifty thousand dollars, or asmuch thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal yearending June 30, 2009, from the general fund to the department of fishand wildlife for the purposes of this act.
